title: Add OTP Input
content: Create OTP input component. Container: flex gap-2. Digit inputs: w-12 h-14 border-2 rounded-lg text-center text-2xl font-bold, focus:border-blue-500. Auto-focus: first empty input. Auto-advance: move to next input after entry. Backspace: move to previous input and clear. Paste support: handle full code paste.

variants.simple: Create one-time password input with separate digit boxes.
variants.detailed: Create OTP input component. Container: flex gap-2. Digit inputs: w-12 h-14 border-2 rounded-lg text-center text-2xl font-bold, focus:border-blue-500. Auto-focus: first empty input. Auto-advance: move to next input after entry. Backspace: move to previous input and clear. Paste support: handle full code paste.
variants.advanced: Create robust OTP/verification code input. Configuration: length prop (4, 6, or custom), input type (number, alphanumeric). Input boxes: equally sized, clearly separated or with gap, focused input highlighted (ring or border). Auto-focus: focus first input on mount. Auto-advance: after valid input, focus next. Backspace behavior: clear current then focus previous, allow editing previous. Arrow keys: navigate between inputs. Paste handling: intercept paste, distribute digits across inputs, trigger onChange if complete. Mobile: inputmode="numeric" for number pad, autocomplete="one-time-code" for SMS autofill. Validation: only accept valid characters (digits or alphanumeric based on type). Error state: red border on all inputs, error message below. Timer: optional resend countdown, "Resend code" button after expiry. Masked input: optional hide entered digits (dots like password). Completion callback: onComplete fires when all digits entered. Auto-submit: optional submit form when complete. Clear button: reset all inputs. Accessibility: single input with aria-label for screen readers, or group with individual labels. Loading state: disabled during verification. Success state: visual confirmation before navigation.
